# stripe_metronome_product (Resource)

A USAGE, FIXED, SUBSCRIPTION, or COMPOSITE Metronome product. Destroy archives the product.

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) USAGE, FIXED, SUBSCRIPTION, or COMPOSITE.

### Optional

- `billable_metric_id` (String) Required for USAGE; omit for other types.
- `composite_product_ids` (List of String) Required for COMPOSITE products.
- `composite_tags` (List of String) Required for COMPOSITE products.

### Read-Only
